name: Autoencoders (AE, VAE)
summary: Autoencoders and variational autoencoders for EEMs and absorbance, also on the coefficients of a functional basis, with latent-space tools, anomaly detection and saved models.
description: Adds the page Autoencoders to the experimental methods. A neural network learns a few numbers (the latent code) that describe each sample, and rebuilds the sample from them. Variational autoencoders also learn what a typical code looks like, so they can draw new, similar samples and tell when a sample is unusual. The functional versions work on the coefficients of the basis chosen as for the functional PCA, and have a smoothing setting (smoothify). The codes become variables you can plot, cluster and classify, and a fitted network can be saved and applied to new samples. Installing it downloads about 150 MB of extra libraries (PyTorch, CPU version).
